Load penetration test on RS soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (narrowly graded)), intermediate; apparatus: LPT fixture; loading: static penetration. Recorded: load vs penetration. One of 2 tests drawn from the same figures.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, bin or mold, fill depth are not reported.
:::
